headline: USDA Declares US Cattle Supply Safe Amid Screwworm Rise
summary: The U.S. Agriculture Department stated the cattle supply remains safe despite rising screwworm cases in animals caused by heavy rains in the Southwest.
why: Livestock health and safety declarations directly impact U.S. agricultural markets and beef supply chains.

impacts.name: US Agriculture Sector
impacts.why: Official confirmation of cattle supply safety mitigates immediate systemic risk from screwworm cases.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
